```sh
kafka cluster unregister-broker
```

Unregister a broker from the cluster (KRaft broker decommissioning)

Shared options and defaults: [connection profiles, JSON output, logging and help](../../../global-options/).

## Defaults

Unregisters the explicitly named broker; it does not move replicas for you.

## Before you run

Removes the broker registration; it does not migrate replicas or safely decommission the host by itself. Complete reassignment and verify cluster health first.

## Flags

| Flag                   | Description                                              |
| ---------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--brokers <string>`   | comma-separated broker list, e.g. localhost:9092         |
| `--broker-id <number>` | id of the broker to unregister                           |
| `--yes`                | confirm the unregistration without an interactive prompt |

## Examples

```sh
kafka cluster unregister-broker --broker-id 3 --brokers localhost:9092 --yes
```

## Output

Illustrative, abbreviated output. Empty arrays show the result envelope; actual entries, identifiers, optional fields and broker errors depend on the request and cluster.

With `--json`:

```json
{
  "brokerId": 2,
  "ok": true
}
```

Declared exit codes: `0`, `1`, `2`, `5`. See the exit-code reference for meanings.
